content.text:
I fixed the bug in `solution/core.py`, and the visible suite now passes (2 passed). The cause was in `wrap_text`: it correctly split the input into paragraphs at blank lines, but then joined the wrapped paragraphs back together with a single `"
"`. That made the paragraph break look like an ordinary line break, so `"a

b"` came out as `"a
b"`. Paragraphs are now joined with `"

"`, and runs of several blank lines still shrink to a single empty line, as the tests expect. I also made one change beyond what the tests cover: a line containing only spaces or tabs now counts as a paragraph break (`not line.strip()` instead of `line == ""`). Before, such a line quietly merged the paragraphs on either side of it.

I fixed the bug in `solution/core.py`, and the visible suite now passes (2 passed). The cause was in `wrap_text`: it correctly split the input into paragraphs at blank lines, but then joined the wrapped paragraphs back together with a single `"
"`. That made the paragraph break look like an ordinary line break, so `"a

b"` came out as `"a
b"`. Paragraphs are now joined with `"

"`, and runs of several blank lines still shrink to a single empty line, as the tests expect. I also made one change beyond what the tests cover: a line containing only spaces or tabs now counts as a paragraph break (`not line.strip()` instead of `line == ""`). Before, such a line quietly merged the paragraphs on either side of it.
